{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print("Shape before deduplication:", trial_data.shape)

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
deduplicated_data = trial_data.loc[trial_data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

print("Shape after deduplication:", deduplicated_data.shape)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", deduplicated_data['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN
deduplicated_data['biomarker_baseline'] = deduplicated_data['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = deduplicated_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean(numeric_only=True)

mean_baseline"}
